item.text: I’ll check the timestamp format in the CSV and count the orders placed on June 10 in UTC.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import csv
from datetime import datetime, timezone, date
with open(\"data/orders.csv\", newline=\"\") as f:
    matches = [r[\"order_id\"] for r in csv.DictReader(f) if datetime.fromisoformat(r[\"timestamp\"].replace(\"Z\", \"+00:00\")).astimezone(timezone.utc).date() == date(2026, 6, 10)]
print(len(matches), len(set(matches)))
PY"
